supplierInvite.wrongEmailTitle: Signed in with a different email
supplierInvite.wrongEmailBody: This invite was sent to {invited}, but you are signed in as {signedIn}.
supplierInvite.wrongEmailHint: Sign out and sign back in with {invited} to accept this invite.
supplierInvite.hasCompanyBody: Your account already belongs to another company on the platform. To accept this invite, please sign in with a different email address.
supplierInvite.title: {company} would like to see your security profile
supplierInvite.intro: {company} falls under NIS2 and has to check how securely its suppliers work. Instead of its own questionnaire it uses nisd2.eu: you answer the unified questionnaire once and release it to every customer who asks.
supplierInvite.countryHint: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, for example DE or AT.
supplierInvite.freeNote: The supplier portal costs nothing. Most suppliers do not fall under NIS2 themselves, and this form does not assume you do.
supplierInvite.notHereTitle: We can't open this invitation here
supplierInvite.notHereBody: If the company has sent you a newer email, use the link in that one. Otherwise it runs the nisd2.eu software on its own server, and the invitation is kept there, with its message if it has one.
supplierInvite.notHereNext: You can still fill in your security profile here, at no cost. Then, under Customers, add the person who wrote to you, with the address from the email. They get a link to read your answers without an account of their own.
